credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of David McAlpin, leaning back, wrapped in a wool blanket over his head, clutching a box of Bisquick in his lap.  This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Untitled (David McAlpin)
